This touring production of Mamma Mia! delivers an infectious combination of joy, humor and genuine heart.
Few productions have maintained the kind of global appeal that Mamma Mia! has enjoyed since its debut.
A jukebox musical based on the music of ABBA, MAMMA MIA! knows exactly what it is and makes absolutely no apologies for it.
Until May 17, Edmonton audiences are invited to fall in love again with this feel-good production at the Northern Auditorium.
Mamma Mia! is a delightfully cheerful and charmingly-quirky musical that had audiences roaring with applause and laughter.
Is Mamma Mia good? No, not particularly, and the corner-cutting on the touring production doesn’t help matters.

An evening spent at the theater bopping your head to familiar songs while you escape into a beloved story for a few hours is likely the very reset many people need right now.
It proved on Tuesday’s opening night to be a delightful immersion in the ABBA-verse, bursting with energy and infectious enthusiasm.
The ABBA Musical hasn’t lost an iota of its crowd-pleasing heart and pizzazz in the decades since its Music Center debut.
This is a faithful, joyful rendition that will be hard for anyone not to celebrate.
Phyllida Lloyd’s direction preserves the reliably vivacious heartbeat that’s made this musical so enduring.
You’ll have the fun of fab costumes, a cast of singer/dancers who never say when, and ABBA hits without the burden of the play.

This large ensemble rocks the house from start to finish with spirited performances and fav songs like “Dancing Queen,” Honey, Honey” “Knowing Me, Knowing You” among many others, with the vocals impressively complemented by Anthony Van Laast’s robust choreography.
You'll have a ton of fun with this one.
Frothy, unpretentious stuff, which is likely why it survives and continues to thrive through an unending theatrical tour and series of hit movies.

Whether you're a lifelong ABBA fan or simply looking for a fun night at the theater, this production delivers pure joy from beginning to end.

cn.t: Critics celebrate this feel-good ABBA musical as irresistibly entertaining, praising its infectious energy, catchy hits, and powerhouse performances that deliver exactly what audiences want: pure joy and fun.
